# Crypto Helpers

Just a bunch of handy crypto tools so we don't have to rewrite this stuff everywhere.

## What it does

- Whips up new seed phrases using `bip39-mnemonic`.
- Derives keypairs from those seeds for the vault and noise stuff.
- Saves your seed phrase as plain text (`localStorage['vault-seedphrase']` in the browser, a `.vault-seedphrase` file in the folder the cli runs in).
- Wraps `sodium-universal` so it works smoothly in both Node.js and the browser without throwing a fit.

## API

```javascript
const crypto_helpers = require('crypto-helpers')

// Load the saved seed phrase of 'vault' or make and save a new one
const { mnemonic, seed, keypair } = await crypto_helpers.get_or_create_keypair('vault')

// The keypair from a given seed phrase (or a new random one), nothing is saved
const data = await crypto_helpers.create_mnemonic_keypair({ mnemonic })

// Save / load only the seed phrase
await crypto_helpers.save(mnemonic, 'vault')
const phrase = await crypto_helpers.load('vault') // null if there is none
```

The seed phrase has 24 words. Right now every device makes its own one, and its keypair is that devices network key (the identity module joins hyperswarm with it), so it is a device key, not a recovery phrase for the vault yet, though it very soon will be that.
